changelog: Alpha Party Window v1.31-alpha: Mobile-optimized external action dock, auto-anchored bottom chat scroll, header player name cycling (profile vs account), mention action in quick popup, and pure static mode.
added: External floating side action dock (prevents misclicks on mobile)
Header player name cycle button (🔄) to switch between Profile Names and Account Names
Direct @ Mention option when clicking any player under the Party Name or Roster
Pure static mode with complete bar & border hiding when animations are turned off
Auto-scroll anchor to guarantee newest chats are never clipped on window open
changed: Stretched bottom input text bar and enlarged Send button for smooth thumb tapping
Clean non-emoji Kick Vote / Kick Player popup dialog
Zero left-margin text alignment in chat and text bar
Removed scrollable dialog clutter on player actions
